title: Albumin-normalized bilirubin did not establish incremental cross-cycle prediction of airflow physiology
abstract: In exploratory NHANES 2007–2008 to 2011–2012 transfer (n=3527/3463), log(bilirubin/albumin) spline augmentation reduced survey-weighted FEV1/FVC MSE from 0.00468995 to 0.00467779 (delta -0.00001216; joint PSU-bootstrap 95% [-0.00006210, +0.00006442]). The registered improvement criterion failed; incremental predictive utility was not established. Source-only penalty selection and highest-quality/never-smoker checks did not establish robust improvement. Exploratory independent-cycle transfer, not untouched confirmation or a causal claim.
